leftButtons.description: The buttons that will appear on the left side of the bottom bar.

leftButtonsVisibilityMap.description:
Map to show/hide buttons on the left bottom side of the bottom bar.
This config will be used as a reference to whether show or hide the left buttons of the bottom bar.
If no `leftButtonsVisibilityMap` is provided, all `leftButtons` will be shown by default.
If a leftButton is not provided to the map and it exists in the `leftButtons` array,
that leftButton will be shown by default.

Have the following configuration as an example:
```
"leftButtons": [
 { "id": "SDLDemo.TextDangerGhostLarge" },
 { "id": "SDLDemo.IconArrow" },
 { "id": "SDLDemo.LoadingPrimaryOutlineMedium" }
],
"leftButtonsVisibilityMap": {
 "SDLDemo.TextDangerGhostLarge": false
},
```
The `SDLDemo.IconArrow` and `SDLDemo.LoadingPrimaryOutlineMedium` inputs will be shown,
while the `SDLDemo.TextDangerGhostLarge` button will be hidden.

rightButtons.description: The buttons that will appear on the right side of the bottom bar.

rightButtonsVisibilityMap.description:

Have the following configuration as an example:
```
"rightButtons": [
 { "id": "SDLDemo.TextDangerGhostLarge" },
 { "id": "SDLDemo.IconArrow" },

```
The `SDLDemo.IconArrow` and `SDLDemo.LoadingPrimaryOutlineMedium` inputs will be shown,
while the `SDLDemo.TextDangerGhostLarge` button will be hidden.
